#### Pattern

```text
System.String Pattern { get; set; }
```

Gets the detected error pattern.


Remarks: Common patterns: SELF_REFERENCE - Record references itself before creation MISSING_PARENT - References a record not yet created in same batch MISSING_REFERENCE - References a record that doesn&#x27;t exist in target
